notes: Restores the full Legacy Media Gallery as a modular React Media Library under Settings / Administration.

Media Library supports upload from PC, browse/search/filter, reference visibility, attach or reassign images to firearms, Main Photo/Other roles, replace image, and physical delete with reference warning.
Reuses the same media service introduced for Appearance & Branding so branding and firearm assignment share one media subsystem.
Adds Media Library to the Settings submenu and Settings landing page.
Continues modularization with a standalone MediaLibraryPage rather than adding gallery management back into main.tsx.
